data.name: PowerScripts_AgentSetupInstructions
data.value:
Help me set up the PowerToys PowerScripts skill for this AI agent.
The complete bundled skill is available locally at: "{0}"
Read SKILL.md in that folder, then copy the entire bundle, including all references, into the skills location supported by this agent, using powertoys-powerscripts as the destination folder name. If a copy already exists, compare it and ask before replacing any user changes. Do not delete existing skills.
Use the agent's documented reload or discovery mechanism and verify that the skill is available. If this agent does not support skills, read the bundled instructions directly and explain the limitation. Remote, cloud, and WSL agents require separate setup; do not assume Windows paths are accessible there.
Once ready, ask what I want to automate and use the skill to help author and validate PowerScripts. Follow its consumer and runtime guidance. Installing the skill does not approve scripts or grant permissions: do not approve or execute scripts, change bindings, enable integrations, or weaken sandbox settings without my explicit consent.
